extraction.method: English paraphrase of the public Task behavior contract; no private API or server implementation is inferred.
extraction.location: Collaboration / Tasks: task identity, creation, statuses, ownership, task thread, board, and agent workflow sections.

observed: A Task is a top-level channel or direct-message message with a channel-local number, status, and optional single owner.
The five visible statuses are Todo, In progress, In review, Done, and Closed.
Every Task is anchored to a thread; progress and review discussion live in that thread.
An Agent claims a Task before work, posts progress in the thread, submits for review, and completion follows review rather than provider process exit.
taskSemantics.nonEvidence: The public documentation does not provide Raft Server database, idempotency, lease, or crash-recovery source code.
